content.title: Sweetgreen (NYSE:SG) Misses Q3 Revenue Estimates, Stock Drops
content.summary: Casual salad chain Sweetgreen (NYSE:SG) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales flat year on year at $172.4 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $685 million at the midpoint came in 2.5% below analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP loss of $0.31 per share was 76.2% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
